name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows tucked near your ribs and curl both dumbbells upward toward your shoulders using an underhand grip.
At the top of the curl, rotate your forearms so your palms face forward and downward into an overhand grip.
Lower the dumbbells slowly with palms facing down, then turn your palms back up at the bottom before starting the next repetition.
tips: Control the overhand lowering phase slowly to get the full benefit for your forearms and brachioradialis.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and avoid swinging your torso.
